how_to_apply: TNFWCCB Recruitment 2026 applications must be submitted online only, through the official application portal. The notification outlines the following steps:
Keep ready a valid e-mail ID, mobile number, and Aadhaar number.
Keep ready a scanned recent passport-size photograph and signature.
Keep ready self-attested (signed) scanned copies, PDF preferred (DigiLocker or e-issued copies where available), of the certificates and mark sheets for every qualification and experience entered.
Sign in with your e-mail address; a one-time password (OTP) will be sent to it.
Fill in the application, upload the supporting document against each entry, accept the terms and conditions, and submit. The application, once submitted, is final.
Note the application number and retain a print-out of the application for your records.

A candidate may submit only one application per position through the portal; a separate application must be submitted for each position the candidate wishes to be considered for. No hard copy of the application needs to be submitted unless specifically called for by the Bureau.

content_sections.heading: TNFWCCB Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Essential qualification requirements differ by post. A summary of the essential qualification for each post is given below; desirable/added-advantage qualifications from the notification are noted separately where applicable. The notification does not mention any age relaxation for reserved categories; this detail is not specified in the provided document. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Tech./M.E. in Cyber Forensics / Digital Forensics / Cyber Security, or M.Sc. in Cyber Forensics / Digital Forensics / Cyber Security from a recognized University. CFA-01 requires a minimum of 2 years of relevant professional experience in digital/cyber forensics; CFA-02 requires a minimum of 3 years. Both require proficiency in Cellebrite Inseyets/UFED and C5 CDR Analyzer, and adequate knowledge of Digital Forensics including mobile, computer, network and cloud forensics.
Graduation in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or Mathematics with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks from a recognised university, along with specialized course completion in Data Analysis.

Bachelor's Degree in Law (LL.B./B.L.) from a University recognized by the Bar Council of India, enrolment as an Advocate with a State Bar Council, and a minimum of 2 years of professional experience in legal practice, legal research, litigation or related legal work.

Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Geography, Geo-informatics, Remote Sensing & Forestry, or a related discipline from a recognized University (a Post Graduate Diploma/Diploma in GIS & Remote Sensing may also be considered where the candidate has a relevant Bachelor's Degree), along with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in GIS, spatial analysis, mapping or related work.

Master's Degree in Wildlife Science, Forestry, Zoology, Botany, Environmental Science, Life Science, Social Science, Management or related disciplines from a recognized University, along with experience in training coordination, capacity building, programme management, or related work.

Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Rural Development, Mass Communication, Journalism, Environmental Science, Wildlife Science, Forestry or related disciplines from a recognized University, along with minimum experience in community outreach, public awareness, communication, social development or related work.

Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University, plus a Diploma/Certificate in Computer Applications or equivalent computer qualification, along with experience in toll-free helpline/call centre operations, data entry, computer operation or public grievance handling.

Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University, plus a Diploma/Certificate in Computer Applications or equivalent computer qualification, along with experience in helpline operation, call centre operations, data entry, computer operation or public grievance handling.

Postgraduate (PG) degree in Environmental Science, Sustainability, Public Policy, Climate Change, Agriculture, or related disciplines. OR an Undergraduate (UG) degree with a minimum of 2 years of active field experience.

content_sections.heading: TNFWCCB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection under TNFWCCB Recruitment 2026 will be based on shortlisting of applications, considering educational qualifications, experience, and suitability for the post, along with a Practical Skill Assessment where applicable. Shortlisted candidates will then undergo a personal interview. The date and time of the interview will be intimated individually by e-mail to shortlisted candidates. Reservation details are not specified in the provided notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TNFWCCB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: TNFWCCB Recruitment 2026 applications must be submitted online only, through the official application portal. The notification outlines the following steps: Keep ready a valid e-mail ID, mobile number, and Aadhaar number. Keep ready a scanned recent passport-size photograph and signature. Keep ready self-attested (signed) scanned copies, PDF preferred (DigiLocker or e-issued copies where available), of the certificates and mark sheets for every qualification and experience entered. Sign in with your e-mail address; a one-time password (OTP) will be sent to it. Fill in the application, upload the supporting document against each entry, accept the terms and conditions, and submit. The application, once submitted, is final. Note the application number and retain a print-out of the application for your records. Check the application status, and, if shortlisted, download the interview call letter, on the same portal by signing in with the same e-mail. A candidate may submit only one application per position through the portal; a separate application must be submitted for each position the candidate wishes to be considered for. No hard copy of the application needs to be submitted unless specifically called for by the Bureau.

faq.question: Q1. What is TNFWCCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: TNFWCCB Recruitment 2026 refers to Notification No. 01/2026, dated 03.09.2026, issued by the Tamil Nadu Forest and Wildlife Crime Control Bureau for the engagement of 12 temporary, contractual personnel across nine post categories for 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under TNFWCCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 12 positions are available: 2 Cyber Forensics Analyst, 2 Data Analyst, 1 Legal Officer, 1 GIS Expert, 1 Training Coordinator, 1 Community Outreach Officer, 1 Toll Free Operator, 2 Data Entry Operator, and 1 Green Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for TNFWCCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date and time to apply online is 19.09.2026 (Saturday), 05:00 PM. Applications received after this date and time will not be considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for TNFWCCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements vary by post, ranging from a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline (for Data Entry Operator and Toll Free Operator) to specific postgraduate and professional qualifications in Cyber Forensics, Data Science, Law, GIS, Wildlife Science, Social Work, or Environmental Science, depending on the post applied for.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for TNFWCCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit ranges from 35 years to 40 years depending on the post. Cyber Forensics Analyst and Legal Officer posts have a 40-year age limit, while all other posts have a 35-year age limit.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for TNFWCCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee. The notification states that the selection process is transparent and free of cost, and no payment of any kind is required at any stage.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for TNFWCCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through the official online portal by signing in with their e-mail address, verifying via OTP, filling in the application, uploading self-attested scanned documents, and submitting the form before the last date.
